explore.subtitle: Alpine Experiences of Exception
explore.title: Valais with Heidi
explore.description:
Discover the authenticity of the Valaisian mountains. Enjoy the gentle altitude and the scent of pine trees to experience a rich and enriching experience in a preserved environment. Here, no artifice, we let you taste the traditions of the fabulous Alpine park. Get to know passionate people who have preserved the art of simplicity and authenticity. 

 Activities, gourmet walks, discovery of the mountain, fauna, flora and nature activities to draw together your most beautiful memories of the Valais.
explore.noPrestations: No prestations available at the moment.

quiEstHeidi.subtitle: Local, authentic and passionate
quiEstHeidi.title: Who is Heidi?
quiEstHeidi.description: Founder & "Happiness Dealer" of Beeheidi, Sandra is the granddaughter of an alpinist who passed on to her a taste for the mountains.
quiEstHeidi.description2:
After spending her summers at altitude, wandering through fields of flowers, it was only natural that everyone started calling her Heidi. She doesn't practice trail running for the love of competition, but rather because she knows the best blueberry pies are hidden in the heart of the alpine pastures.

Through this project, Heidi wants to create connections and offer unforgettable, fresh emotions filled with simplicity and great human richness, in the heart of one of the most beautiful natural amusement parks — the Alps. Her philosophy is that it is our duty to make life gentle and happy.

On the eve of her 40th birthday, understanding that this fleeting passage here should not be filled with regrets, she wisely decides to take the plunge and bring to life everything she had always sketched in a notebook and that had remained in the drawer labelled: "Maybe one day".

On 21 May 2019, Beeheidi was founded by Sandra Rouiller & Stéphane Berclaz, her business partner but above all her life companion. Beeheidi, a melodic little word paying tribute to Grandpa Happy-culteur.

aboutHeidi.title: Sandra, Beeheidi's Founder
aboutHeidi.description:
Daughter of an alpinist and beekeeper, Sandra grew up to the rhythm of the Valaisian seasons. Passionate about the mountains, she founded Beeheidi with a simple conviction: share the authenticity of the Alps and create lasting emotions.

Every experience she designs bears her signature — generosity, nature and alpine art de vivre.

ourTeam.title: Stéphane, mountain guide
ourTeam.description:
A certified guide and lover of the terrain, Stéphane shares his intimate knowledge of Valais through every outing.

Together, Sandra and Stéphane form a complementary duo, united by the same passion: showing you an authentic Valais, off the beaten track.

guidesTeam.title: The team who supports us
guidesTeam.paragraph1: Beeheidi has surrounded itself with guides, mountain companions and enthusiasts spread across the canton, chosen for their skills and, above all, for their human qualities, their love of the region and their eagerness to share it.
guidesTeam.paragraph2: Genuine lovers of nature and local terroir, they are excellent ambassadors for their region. They know the best alpine pastures for tasting a fruit tart made by grandma, as well as where the finest sérac cheese is crafted. Born with a built-in GPS, they spot the best places to admire a stunning sunrise or sunset and know exactly where to stop for the magic to happen.
guidesTeam.paragraph3: Beeheidi also works with various independent providers — mountain guides, outdoor guides, restaurateurs and more. They are all professionals who will give you wonderful experiences and introduce you to unique locations off the beaten track.
guidesTeam.paragraph4: Above all, we love sharing our playground and want to help visitors discover it through our eyes, in all simplicity.

inAFewWords.title: Beeheidi in a few words
inAFewWords.content: Beeheidi is not just a service company, but also a brand that brings together a community connected to the Alps, the local terroir and its traditions.

generalities.title: GENERALITIES
generalities.content: The terms and conditions (T&Cs) stated below apply to all services provided by Beeheidi Sàrl and to clients who reside in and outside of Switzerland, with the exception of the online shop. Any individual placing an order declares they have read and agreed to the present T&Cs. In addition, provisions from the Swiss Code of Obligations (RS 220) apply.

contract.title: CONCLUSION OF THE CONTRACT BASED ON THE PRESENT T&Cs
contract.content: The T&Cs take effect immediately after the booking order is confirmed or the quote has been signed by the client who then becomes the co-contracting party. Any modification that may occur after the signature of the booking confirmation, causing a readjustment of agreed services or extra costs, will be charged accordingly.
contract.content2: The co-contracting party accepts full responsibility for the financial consequences of a cancellation after the booking confirmation has been signed.

prices.title: PRICES
prices.content: The prices of services/products correspond to the date the proposal was sent to the client. They appear in Swiss Francs and do not include VAT. The stated prices are guaranteed during the offer's validity period. For offers published on our website www.beeheidi.ch, prices are indicative and will be confirmed with client when a proposal is sent.

payment.title: PAYMENT PROCEDURES
payment.content: The payment procedure is established according to the conditions of each offer.
payment.content2: In case of late payment, Beeheidi Sàrl reserves the right to charge reminder fees, and, where appropriate, to terminate the contract with immediate effect.
payment.content3: All services provided by Beeheidi Sàrl are charged and received only via post office or bank transfer. Credit card payments are accepted and may be subject to additional fees.

liability.title: LIABILITY RELEASE
liability.content: Beeheidi Sàrl cannot be held responsible for services provided by independent contractors or third parties that are not directly run by Beeheidi Sàrl (art. 101 al.2 CO), such as extra costs, delays, unforeseen circumstances, etc.
liability.content2: Beeheidi Sàrl accepts no responsibility for damages (accident, injury, etc.) the client is exposed to that may be caused by circumstances out of Beeheidi's control.
liability.content3: Beeheidi Sàrl cannot be held liable for any unpredictable risks and/or risks linked to the client's or the participant's behaviour. In other words, the client accepts full responsibility for the risks associated with outdoor activities which may be unavoidable despite meticulous and cautious planning.
liability.content3Highlight: Any outdoor activity may involve an element of risk, the client as well as all the participants confirm that they have the appropriate equipment and sufficient physical abilities for the practice of such activities. Furthermore, the participant must not be under the influence of substances that could compromise their safety and that of others.
liability.content4: In order to carry out the activity in the safest environment possible, the client must respect the instructions provided by Beeheidi Sàrl and any affiliated partner at all times. The client is required to immediately inform Beeheidi Sàrl and/or any affiliated partner of any potential concern, physical condition and/or psychological issue that may affect him. The client is held responsible for informing all participants in an activity managed by Beeheidi Sàrl about this safety clause.
liability.content5: Minors must be accompanied by their legal representative, or by an adult appointed by the legal representative.

insurance.title: INSURANCE
insurance.content: Beeheidi Sàrl and any affiliated partner are covered by a professional third-party liability insurance. However, the client accepts full responsibility in case of loss, injury, death, or damage caused to a third party or himself, that may occur during one of the activities organised by Beeheidi Sàrl.
insurance.content2: Each participant must have a personal accident and health insurance that covers mountain rescue services (such as AirGlacier, Rega, …) as well as a third-party liability insurance, that includes all the services and activities provided.
insurance.content3: Furthermore, each participant accepts full responsibility in case of damage, loss or theft of equipment belonging to Beeheidi Sàrl or an affiliated partner.

cancellation.title: CANCELLATION FROM CO-CONTRACTING PARTY
cancellation.content: The co-contracting party must address a written cancellation request to Beeheidi Sàrl. The client accepts that fees will apply. The reservation is transferable but cannot be exchanged or refunded.
cancellation.content2: If the minimum number of participants has not been reached, Beeheidi Sàrl reserves the right to cancel the stay or the activity, therefore refunding the registered participants. No further financial compensation is to be expected.
cancellation.content3: If the weather conditions do not allow the activity to take place, Beeheidi Sàrl reserves the right to cancel the stay or the activity and will provide a full refund. No further financial compensation is to be expected. Beeheidi Sàrl does not provide a cancellation insurance.
cancellation.content4: Clients are responsible for arranging their own cancellation insurance.

forceMajeure.title: FORCE MAJEURE CLAUSE
forceMajeure.content: If Beeheidi Sàrl considers that an activity or a trip should not start or should be interrupted before its end due to unforeseen circumstances (eg. Natural disaster, pandemic, political issues, or travel is not recommended, etc.), or under the order of competent authorities, Beeheidi Sàrl cannot be held responsible. Furthermore, the company has the right to deduct from the amount refunded to the participant any costs/expenditures already made on their behalf. Any entitlement to financial compensation is excluded.

confidentiality.title: CONFIDENTIALITY CLAUSE
confidentiality.content: Information shared between Beeheidi Sàrl and the co-contracting party in the context of the mandate regarding the provided services shall be treated in full confidentiality.

interpretation.title: INTERPRETATION OF THE PRESENT CONDITIONS
interpretation.content: The T&Cs and all communication between Beeheidi Sàrl and the co-contracting party may be used to interpret the wishes of the co-contracting parties in the context of the services provided.

jurisdiction.content: In the event of any dispute between Beeheidi Sàrl and the co-contracting party regarding the execution, non-execution, application or interpretation of the T&Cs, the court of jurisdiction is in Sierre (CH).
